items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: But Richard Jones, I know he played in the parlors.

ctx.x: Well, I tell you, they had a house. I had a sporting house of Louise Aberdee and Louise Blackenstein. But Richard Jones, I know he played in the parlors.
When did you first meet Morten? Excuse me.
